title: Size designation of clothes - Men's and boys' underwear, nightwear and shirts
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 14484) covers Size designation of clothes - Men's and boys' underwear, nightwear and shirts. This Indian Standard which Is identical with ISO 441 5 : 1 981 "Size designation of clothes — Men's and boys' underwear, nightwear and shirts", issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), was adopted by the Sectional Committee and approval of the Textile Division Council. This standard supersedes IS 1 001 5 (Part 5) : 1 983 to align National Standard with the corresponding internatbnal Standard. Technical Corrigendum 1 to the above International Standard has also been incorporated. The text of ISO standard has been approved as suitable for publication as Indian Standard without deviations. Certain conventions are, however, not identical to those used in Indian Standards. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
